subtitle: Lesson 17 · Before the design, the conversation

eyebrow: A symptom vs. a root cause
code:
Symptom (what's said):
  "People are confused about approval."

Root cause (what discovery finds):
  No entry criteria exists at all --
  EVERY request gets the same review.
caption: Designing straight from the symptom fixes the wrong thing.
